radiant.text: Give a Unit Reborn. Make it Radiant.

base.text:
Spell Damage +3
Cry: Cast {casts|random Spell|random Spells}. Each aims at enemies when it harms and at your side when it helps.

radiant.text:
Spell Damage +7
Cry: Cast {casts|random Radiant Spell|random Radiant Spells}. Each aims at enemies when it harms and at your side when it helps.

base.text:
Choose one: Military, Education, Culture or Healthcare.
Military: Your Units on the field, in your hand and in your deck get +2X Attack and Rush.
Education: Shuffle 2X random Radiant Books into your deck. They have Cast on draw and aim at enemies when they harm and at your side when they help.
Culture: Each card on your field, in your hand and in your deck has a 10X% chance to become Radiant.
Healthcare: Your Units on the field, in your hand and in your deck get +2X Health and Armor X.

radiant.text:
Choose one: Military, Education, Culture or Healthcare.
Military: Your Units on the field, in your hand and in your deck get +5X Attack and Rush.
Education: Shuffle 5X random Radiant Books into your deck. They have Cast on draw and aim at enemies when they harm and at your side when they help.
Culture: Each card on your field, in your hand and in your deck has a 25X% chance to become Radiant.
Healthcare: Your Units on the field, in your hand and in your deck get +7X Health and Armor 2X.
